report_summary: AgentControl enforces one validated project-local handoff across all five launch tools before any worker/workflow row is created, persists its resolved path/ID/SHA-256, injects them into worker runtime contracts, and lets Dispatch display only digest-verified content with a per-refresh shared cache. Focused tests pin forwarding, rejection, propagation, rendering, and substitution defense.

The mandatory handoff is enforced on all five public launch tools, validated before any worker/workflow row is created, persisted as trusted ID/absolute-path/SHA-256 metadata, injected into worker contracts, and integrity-checked by the Dispatch dashboard. Focused TypeScript and Python tests pin forwarding, rejection, propagation, rendering, and substitution defense.

The mandatory handoff path is implemented end to end: all five launch tools require one project-local v1 Markdown handoff, Python validates it before any ledger row or process/pending launch, then persists and injects ID/path/SHA-256. Workers receive a read-first/revalidate/report contract, while Dispatch’s monitor verifies the digest, caches shared reads per refresh, and exposes an H view without showing substituted content.

AgentControl handoff is enforced end to end: all five launch tools require a project-local v1 document, Python validates it before any worker/workflow row exists, then persists and injects ID/path/SHA-256; workers receive read-first/revalidation instructions, while Dispatch’s monitor rechecks the digest and suppresses changed content.
